name: Hiiragi Kaede
source: Haruyoshi's classmate. She lives alone in a small apartment and often visits the Nagahara Mansion. Her record is pretty mysterious and she seems to be keeping an eye on Haruyoshi and the people around him. She often hangs out with him and Nagahara.
